```{r}
hist(airquality$Wind, col='skyblue', xlab="Daily Average Wind Speeds (mhp)", main="La Guardia Airport from May to September, 1973")
```
```{r}
myAirquality <- airquality %>% 
  mutate(
    MonthName = case_when(
      Month == 5 ~ 'May'
      Month == 6 ~ 'June'
      Month == 7 ~ 'July'
      Month == 8 ~ 'August'
    )
  )
myAirquality
```


```{r}
# Filter rows where Wind is between 8 and 10
days <- airquality[airquality$Wind >= 8 & airquality$Wind <= 10, ]

# Count the number of rows
nrow(days)

head(days)
```

```{r}
boxplot(Wind ~ Month, airquality, col="steelblue")
```

```{r}
plot(Ozone ~ Temp, airquality, pch=16, col='steelblue')
```
